title: Analog-to-Analog Conversion: AM, FM, PM
titleBn: অ্যানালগ থেকে অ্যানালগ: AM, FM, PM
keyPoints: AM: only the amplitude of the carrier changes; bandwidth is twice the modulating signal’s bandwidth (slide 31).
FM: carrier frequency follows the modulating voltage; amplitude and phase constant (slide 33).
FM: Δf = kf·Am, independent of fm; PM: Δφ = kp·Am, equivalent Δf = kp·Am·fm (slides 37–38).
